summary: Full end-to-end test of Glint MVP (backend + frontend). Ran 33 pytest cases hitting the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL covering auth (register-init/verify-otp/login/forgot/reset), users (me, update, get-by-username, search, unauth), friends (request/accept/list/suggestions), posts (create text/photo/poll, feed, single, react, save/list, hide, comments, delete owner-only, report), stories (create/feed/view/delete + 24h expiry), chat (send/list/muted/heartbeat), verification (submit/me), tickets (create/list), admin (login, stats, tickets+resolve, verifications approve, broadcast/force-update, config, users search, non-admin 403). All 33/33 tests pass (100%). Frontend mobile flow verified: welcome loads, terms checkbox correctly gates step-1 Next (aria-disabled toggles, cannot advance without agreeing), full registration completes via OTP surfaced in an in-app toast (also captured from register-init response), success screen reached, home tab loads real feed with broadcast banner ('hello all'), 4-tab layout (Home/Friends/Chats/Profile) rendered. Admin route /admin/login works with the seeded admin credentials and dashboard shows live stats (Users/Posts/Stories/Pending Verify/Open Tickets/Reports) plus tickets with reply/resolve. No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only observation: a benign console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' surfaced repeatedly.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged on every screen load. Some component is passing pointerEvents as a prop instead of via style. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend (likely in shared UI components using View/Pressable).

action_items: Migrate any `pointerEvents='...'` prop usage to style.pointerEvents on the offending View/Pressable component to remove the React Native deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1250 lines and mixes all domains; consider splitting into routers (auth, users, friends, posts, stories, chat, admin, files) once other features stabilize.
GET /api/users/search silently returns [] for empty q (documented behavior). Fine.
friend_status 'incoming' vs 'outgoing' logic in /api/users/{username} is correct.
Chat conv id uses '{a}_{b}' path segment; mute route works with URL-encoded id. Fine.
OTP is intentionally returned in dev_otp for preview per spec – flag if this ships to prod.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (good); JWT_SECRET/ADMIN_* pulled from env (good, no hardcoding).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, terms-gated registration, OTP verify, success->home feed, admin login+dashboard)

seed_data_creation: Registered 2 users per test module (test_testa_*, test_testb_*), created several posts (text/poll), a story, chat message, verification submission, ticket. Also created one interactive user via UI (uitest*). Broadcast banner set to 'hello all'. Force-update flag toggled off.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://interactive-glint.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@glint.app / GlintAdmin@2026. Register uses simulated OTP returned in register-init response as dev_otp and shown in in-app toast. Backend uses uuid string ids (no ObjectId). All routes prefixed /api. Pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_glint_api.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no failing tests. Only a non-fatal React Native deprecation warning; recommend grep of the codebase for `pointerEvents=` and move to style.pointerEvents.
